title: Could Haaland do it on a cold, rainy night in Stoke?
checked: The phrase comes from pundit Andy Gray on Sky, about Messi, around 2010 (Goal explainer, The42). Stoke promoted to the PL in 2008, relegated in 2018, 17th in the 2025-26 Championship so still there in 2026-27 (Stoke club page, 2018-19 season page, 2025-26 Championship page). Haaland joined City in 2022, so he has never played a PL game at Stoke. No official stat for rain exists, so we say so. Luton 2-6 Man City, Kenilworth Road, FA Cup fifth round, 27 Feb 2024, Haaland five; first top-flight player to score five in an FA Cup match since George Best's six in 1970 (The National, Sports Mole, ESPN, Haaland page). 36 PL goals in 2022-23, still the PL record (Haaland page). 121 PL goals for City as of 24 Oct 2026, so 'over a hundred and twenty' (Haaland page); top PL scorer with 9 on 2 Nov 2026 (Wikipedia 2026-27 PL). The rain goal is a gamecap prediction (specs/haaland-stoke.json), labelled as our prediction. Weather at Luton not claimed.

lines.text: It's football's oldest test. Around 2010, pundit Andy Gray wondered if even Messi could do it on a cold night at Stoke.
lines.say: It's football's oldest test. Around twenty ten, pundit Andy Gray wondered if even Messi could do it, on a cold night at Stoke.

scene.headline: Could Messi do it at Stoke?
scene.standfirst: A Sky Sports pundit's doubt about the best player in the world becomes football's favourite test: wind, rain and the Britannia Stadium.

lines.text: First problem. Stoke went down in 2018, and they're still in the Championship.
lines.say: First problem. Stoke went down in twenty eighteen, and they're still in the Championship.

lines.text: Haaland joined City in 2022. So he has never played a league game there.
lines.say: Hohland joined City in twenty twenty two. So he has never played a league game there.

lines.text: And nobody keeps an official stat for rain. So we found the closest thing.
February 2024. FA Cup. Kenilworth Road, Luton. Tight, old and loud.
lines.say: February twenty twenty four. F A Cup. Kenilworth Road, Looton. Tight, old, and loud.

lines.text: Haaland scored five. The first top-flight player to do it in the FA Cup since George Best in 1970.
lines.say: Hohland scored five. The first top flight player to do it in the F A Cup since George Best, in nineteen seventy.

items.l: goals in one FA Cup game

lines.text: His first Premier League season? Thirty-six goals. Still the record.
Over a hundred and twenty league goals for City now. And top of the chart again this season, with nine.
So picture it. Stoke back up. A Tuesday night. Sideways rain, the ball skidding off the grass.
Our prediction? One chance in the six-yard box. And he puts it away.
The verdict, on the evidence: yes. He'd do it on a cold, rainy night in Stoke.
